To the Max Construction did an amazing job on my bathroom remodel. The owner, Max Garcia, is outstanding. Max came to the house for a free estimate and started working right away. He takes pride in his work as a craftsman, and is extremely clean. Max took his time to answer every question, and never delayed in his response. I enjoyed having Max and his crew in my house, and look forward to hiring him for the next project. I posted pictures of the bathroom remodel to view his work. I highly recommend "To the Max Construction".
